rules: Primary seats retain independent planning and approval duties.
High triggers set a minimum reasoning level for a unit, not an instruction to escalate a primary already at high or spawn a redundant high worker.
The standing pair is the usual quality floor; extra catalog families never vote silently.
A high primary retains orchestration; use same-family workers when delegation adds value or an xhigh trigger requires stronger reasoning.
Name the extra catalog family when a routing-policy trigger fires and it is available; its output is evidence, never a silent vote.
Internal workers never replace a primary or named cross-lineage reviewer.

Cross-family entry always invokes the receiving qualified primary at default effort as ROLE: peer; only that primary dispatches its own same-family ROLE: worker escalation. A caller never selects a foreign worker directly.
Claude-side internal routing belongs to the Claude primary.
Grok-side internal routing is a CodeFlow instruction to the Grok primary, not a vendor-secret router.
Claude produces design in its native interactive session regardless of host.

Default effort is high, not a ceiling: complex architecture and technical planning use the strongest capable permitted same-family reasoning route suited to the task at high or xhigh; design follows the separate Claude owner and route-status contract.

Assess triggers before work and as difficulty changes. An xhigh_trigger permits direct xhigh without a failed high attempt; routine well-specified work does not escalate automatically. Novelty is not a trigger; complexity and difficulty are.

If Fable is unavailable, the Claude primary may use the documented explicit Opus degraded fallback at the same effort after native preflight, with actual scope and reduced assurance recorded. If Astra is unavailable, the Codex primary may use the documented explicit gpt-5.6-sol degraded fallback under the same conditions. These fallback paths preserve graceful operation but do not qualify or promote an internal worker route.
Unobserved model, effort, worker routing, availability, and usage remain unknown.
A changed concrete binding requires native-interactive qualification before promotion.
